author: FreddyT
quote: GTA 5 starts with an iconic bank heist, immediately throwing you into the criminal underworld that defines Grand Theft Auto. GTA 6, on the other hand, starts with a cuck boyfriend and has you running errands and doing chores for Lucia like you're playing a domestic simulator. Since when did Grand Theft Auto become Grand Theft Household? Where is the chaos, the freedom, the ruthless criminal lifestyle that made this franchise legendary? GTA was always about being a criminal, building an empire, robbing banks, causing absolute mayhem and living life without consequences. Now it feels like we're playing an interactive relationship drama with occasional crime sprinkled in. I didn't wait over a decade to become Jason's personal errand boy.
